title: Incident with Github.com [resolved]
author: SpyCoder77
relevanceReason: 命中 3 个 AI/科技关键词。
textRawHtml:
Just got this message: "No server is currently available to service your request. Sorry about that. Please try refreshing and contact us if the problem persists."

Edit: at the time of posting there was not an incident on githubstatus.com. Now there is. https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/zkxwbgr0cnmx

Original Title: "Tell HN: GitHub Is Overloaded"
textZhHtml:
刚刚收到此消息：“当前没有服务器可以满足您的请求。对此表示抱歉。请尝试刷新，如果问题仍然存在，请联系我们。”

编辑：在发布时，githubstatus.com 上没有发生任何事件。现在有了。 https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/zkxwbgr0cnmx

comments.author: leishman
comments.textRawHtml: I don't understand why Github hasn't solved this problem with pricing updates. My understanding is they are getting hammered with LLM generated code growing their traffic by over an order of magnitude. So why not rate limit non-paying users and charge for whatever scarce resource is being consumed that is causing them to constantly fall-over? This seems like a basic economics problem.
comments.textZhHtml: 我不明白为什么 Github 没有通过定价更新来解决这个问题。我的理解是，他们受到 LLM 生成的代码的打击，其流量增加了一个数量级以上。那么，为什么不对非付费用户进行速率限制，并对正在消耗的稀缺资源进行收费，从而导致他们不断失败呢？这似乎是一个基本的经济学问题。

children.author: noahbp
children.textRawHtml: Because any price at all will immediately cause users to shift to another platform, and GitHub's value is that it is _the_ place to put your code on the internet.
children.textZhHtml: 因为任何价格都会立即导致用户转向另一个平台，而 GitHub 的价值在于它是将代码放在互联网上的_the_地方。

children.author: stusmall
children.textRawHtml: Being the _the_ place for open source is what let them dominate the enterprise.  Now that they dominate the enterprise, it'd make financial sense to put hard limits on the free tier.  It's cynical but it would be foolish to lose that cash machine.  It'd open them up for a competitor to slowly build up good will in open source then take them on in enterprise, but right now they are risking losing it all.
children.textZhHtml: 成为开源的领地是他们在企业中占据主导地位的原因。  既然他们在企业中占据主导地位，那么对免费套餐施加严格限制就具有经济意义。  这很愤世嫉俗，但失去那台提款机就太愚蠢了。  这会让他们向竞争对手敞开大门，慢慢在开源领域建立良好的信誉，然后在企业中与他们较量，但现在他们正面临着失去一切的风险。

children.author: zahlman
children.textRawHtml: I thought "the diff viewer doesn't show files this large" was supposed to be that limit?
children.textZhHtml: 我认为“差异查看器不显示这么大的文件”应该是这个限制？

children.author: dbmikus
children.textRawHtml: Big enterprises are on a different github deployment, so I doubt they are affected by this
children.textZhHtml: 大企业都在不同的github部署上，所以我怀疑他们是否受到了影响

children.author: disgruntledphd2
children.textRawHtml:
> Big enterprises are on a different github deployment, so I doubt they are affected by this

Depends, some of them use GH Enterprise but many (surprisingly) don't.
children.textZhHtml:
> 大企业采用不同的 github 部署，所以我怀疑他们是否受到此影响

取决于，其中一些使用 GH Enterprise，但许多（令人惊讶）不使用。

children.author: throw-the-towel
children.textRawHtml: In my experience, we were typically affected just like everyone else. Maybe a public company with its market cap in the billions isn't big enough.
children.textZhHtml: 根据我的经验，我们通常和其他人一样受到影响。也许市值数十亿的上市公司还不够大。

children.author: ProAm
children.textRawHtml: Self host an infrastructure like real billion dollar companies.
children.textZhHtml: 像真正的价值数十亿美元的公司一样自行托管基础设施。

children.author: snazz
children.textRawHtml: Enterprise Cloud was indeed affected by this (as of this morning)
children.textZhHtml: 企业云确实受到了影响（截至今天早上）

children.author: rtpg
children.textRawHtml:
I don't know how true that is nowadays, I think if you sign up to Enterprise Cloud you're in the same spot as everyone else

(maybe F500 people have their colocated box, but I have the impression that those are the "first class" seats (very expensive but _very few_) whereas enterprise cloud is the "business class" (loooooots of seats making a lot of money)
children.textZhHtml:
我不知道现在这是否属实，我认为如果你注册了企业云，你就和其他人处于同一个位置

（也许F500的人有他们的同位包厢，但我的印象是那些是“头等舱”座位（非常昂贵但_很少_），而企业云是“商务舱”（很多座位赚很多钱）

children.author: ahahs
children.textRawHtml: except the big enterprise I work at was for sure affected by this today haha
children.textZhHtml: 除了我工作的大企业今天肯定受到了影响哈哈

children.author: floro
children.textRawHtml: Increasing prices are a sure way to enshittification. It will push people away from github. Many such previous examples
children.textZhHtml: 提高价格是一种必然的方式。它会让人们远离 github。以前有很多这样的例子

children.author: dannyw
children.textRawHtml:
The network effects isn’t that much, and like what we see with Steam, you want to be where the audience is.

More realistically, MAU or something is a metric/OKR. It’s easy to imagine why a business wouldn’t want to cap that.
children.textZhHtml:
网络效应并没有那么大，就像我们在 Steam 上看到的那样，你希望成为受众所在的地方。

更现实的是，MAU 或其他东西是一个指标/OKR。很容易想象为什么企业不想限制这一点。

children.author: hinkley
children.textRawHtml: Someone did a study that suggested the network effect is logarithmic in nature, but if that’s true it means something with 95% market share is 3 times “better” for having everyone there. Not 20 or two orders of magnitude better but not nothing.
children.textZhHtml: 有人做了一项研究，表明网络效应本质上是对数的，但如果这是真的，那就意味着拥有 95% 市场份额的东西比每个人都在场的“更好”3 倍。不是好 20 或两个数量级，但也不是没有。

children.author: penteract
children.textRawHtml: Please could you link to the study if you can find it. The definition of "better" seems quite critical here, as well as whether it's specific to code hosting websites. A messaging platform is pretty useless if I'm the only user, but Github would still be useful to me without anyone else having an account.
children.textZhHtml: 如果您能找到该研究，请提供该研究的链接。 “更好”的定义在这里似乎非常重要，以及它是否特定于代码托管网站。如果我是唯一的用户，消息平台就毫无用处，但在没有其他人拥有帐户的情况下，Github 对我来说仍然有用。

children.author: graceful6800
children.textRawHtml:
And the audience you want are users who will never, ever pay to get access. If GitHub starts throttling free users, they throttle the audience you're talking about far, far harder than you.

The audience will go away to somewhere you aren't. Then what?
children.textZhHtml:
您想要的受众是永远不会付费才能访问的用户。如果 GitHub 开始限制免费用户，他们对你所谈论的受众的限制会比你严重得多。

受众会离开你，去到你不在的地方。然后呢？

children.author: esseph
children.textRawHtml:
> The network effects isn’t that much

There are people in this thread that have said their biggest reason for not moving away is the network effect.
children.textZhHtml:
> 网络效应并没有那么大

这个话题中有人表示他们没有搬走的最大原因是网络效应。
